newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Group repeats H1 op profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: CS Group repeats H1 op profit forecast.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group's new chief executive Lukas Muehlemann confirmed a May forecast that the group expected operating profit for the first six months to increase 35 percent from a year earlier.
In an interview with the Swiss newspaper Balser Zeitung, Muehlemann was quoted as saying he had nothing to add to the May 30 forecast by group chairman Rainer Gut.

"Gut recently gave the annual shareholder meeting a quantitative forecast by saying that our net result at the operating level will be 35 percent above the year before," Muehlemann told the paper. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
